outcome: women's practices for Mothers' Care in Postpartum Period
cohort: The study participants were 172 multigravida women, divided into an 86-woman study group and an 86-woman control group, selected from primary health care centers in Amara City, Iraq.
finding: The abstract primarily reports the demographic and reproductive characteristics of the study and control groups, but does not present the findings regarding the effectiveness of the educational program itself.
